title: 我在门口
setting: Chongqing Jiangbei airport, arrivals, 11 pm. Your driver is messaging you in the ride-hailing app.

giveup.en: He drove off without you. The next car is forty minutes away, so you get to know arrivals very well.

steps.narr: 11 pm, Chongqing airport. You're outside door 3, in a red jacket.

steps.en: I'm here! And I can't stop here!

say.en: He's asking what you're wearing. Tell him: red!
say.tip: 红 hóng = red. 衣服 yīfu = clothes: 红衣服, red clothes, is how you'd say what you've got on.

ok.en: A giant red chilli with legs: someone in a hotpot-restaurant costume, handing out flyers.

1.tip: 穿 chuān = to wear (clothes, shoes): 我穿红衣服 = I'm wearing red.

say.en: That's a giant chilli! Tell him it isn't you.

not.note: That says it IS you. Put 不 in front: 不是我！

say.tip: 不是我 bú shì wǒ = it's not me. 不 before 是 turns 'it is' into 'it isn't' (and says bú before a fourth tone).

mistakes.note: 没 is for 'didn't' and 'haven't'. For 'it isn't', use 不: 不是我！

1.en: Tell him: no, that's not you!

not.note: That says it IS you. Put 不 in: 那不是我！

1.tip: 那不是我 = that isn't me (那 nà = that). 师傅 shīfu = what you call a driver.

say.en: Tell him where you are: by the door.
say.tip: 门口 ménkǒu = by the door (门 door + 口 mouth, opening). 我在…… = I'm at … .

1.en: Tell him you're right here, at the exit.
1.gloss: I'm right here at the exit.
1.tip: 在……这儿 = right here at … (这儿 zhèr = here). 出口 chūkǒu = exit, the way out.

say.tip: 三号门 sān hào mén = door number three: 号 hào marks a number.

ok.en: Your driver, grinning, holding up a sign: your name, in characters a foot tall.

not.note: 里面 is inside. He's out on the road: 外面 wàimian, outside.

1.tip: 外面 wàimian = outside. 三号门，出来就是 = door 3, right there as you come out.

say.en: There he is, under your name! Thank him: drivers are called 师傅 (shīfu).
say.tip: 师傅 shīfu = what you call a driver (or any skilled worker): 'master'. 谢谢师傅！ is the thank-you every driver hears.

mistakes.note: 师父 is a master who teaches you a craft. A driver is 师傅: the same sound, another 傅.

1.en: You can see him! Say so, and thank him.
1.tip: 看到了 kàndào le = I can see you now (了: it's happened). Add 师傅 for the driver: 看到了，谢谢师傅！

steps.en: He was at door 3 the whole time, ten metres away, under your name in characters a foot tall. Half the arrivals hall now knows your name.
